Surfaces.Contract: Start the caller owner before validation or command construction. Keep it through dispatch, native result inspection, typed conversion and cleanup. Delegated methods borrow it; cache hits and successful calls keep the default failure-only owner.

Boundaries.Name: stream-continuous-read
Boundaries.Contract: Begin iterator ownership before cursor copies, initial $ resolution, command construction and cancellation. All pages and recovery attempts borrow its failure-only lease; release after page cleanup or early iterator disposal. Initial resolution failures are final without recovery.

Boundaries.Name: stream-iterator-final-inspection
Boundaries.Contract: Complete iterator ownership in finally after all borrowed page conversion and cleanup. Publish a caller-visible failure once; successful enumeration and early disposal return the dispatch source without renting error observation storage.
